project: Wuxia Life P52 Sample Lines Baseline Hardening And Cross-Tester Validation
description: Harden the post-P51 three-line sample baseline by adding a second human playtest round, cross-tester comparison evidence, and a small automated guard layer without expanding content scope or reopening the core sample-line pipeline.

userStories.title: Audit current post-P51 evidence gaps
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a concise audit of the remaining post-P51 evidence gaps so P52 hardens the real weak spots instead of reopening closed work.
acceptanceCriteria: Inventory the currently weak evidence items after P51
Separate human-evidence gaps from automated-guard gaps
Save docs/test-reports/p52-baseline-hardening-gap-audit.md
Do not change gameplay behavior in this story

userStories.title: Define round-2 human playtest protocol
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an explicit second-round playtest protocol so cross-tester validation is repeatable instead of conversational.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the seeds, sample lines, recording template, and pass bar for round 2
Define the comparison dimensions against round 1
Define pass, warning, and fail interpretation for round 2
Save the protocol under docs/test-reports/ or a companion doc

userStories.title: Execute human playtest round 2
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a second completed playtest round so the sample-line baseline has cross-tester evidence instead of single-tester proof only.
acceptanceCriteria: A second tester completes the checklist for all three lines
Record retell, continue intent, replay intent, and key-turning-point memory for each line
If warnings exist, explain them in prose rather than only as scores

userStories.title: Archive round-2 playtest results
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the second playtest round archived in a stable repo artifact so later reviews do not depend on ephemeral notes.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p49-sample-lines-playtest-round-2.md
Normalize the round-2 record shape so it matches round-1 closely enough for comparison
Include per-line pass, warning, or fail labels plus short reasoning
Do not mix round-2 raw evidence with cross-tester conclusions in the same file

userStories.title: Produce cross-tester comparison report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a round-1 versus round-2 comparison report so I can judge whether the baseline is stable across different human readers.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce docs/test-reports/p52-cross-tester-playtest-comparison.md
Compare the three lines on retell clarity, cost perception, continue intent, and replay intent
Distinguish normal variation from issues worth tracking
Do not label single-observer preference differences as blockers

userStories.title: Record cross-tester verdict and residual handling
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a small verdict table for cross-tester validation so follow-up work does not have to infer which human differences are actionable.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize which cross-tester differences are acceptable variation versus monitor-only residuals
Call out any line that still needs expression follow-up without reopening P46-P51 blockers
Keep the verdict compact and link it from the comparison report or closure addendum
Do not create new blocking gaps unless both tester rounds support them

userStories.title: Define the minimum automated guard contract
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an explicit minimum guard contract so future work knows which sample-line invariants must not silently regress.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the must-keep invariants for the current baseline
Cover merchant 804 operating-state output, age-40 identity output, cross-line cost distinctness, and playability non-regression
State which guards belong in existing tests versus report or script surfaces
Record the contract in the PRD or a companion report

userStories.title: Add merchant goal bleed regression guard
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a narrow regression guard for the merchant-versus-demonic midlife goal conflict so RW-05 does not silently come back.
acceptanceCriteria: Keep a focused regression for merchant 804 plus parallel route_demonic
Assert merchant line detection and currentGoal remain merchant-facing
Reuse the existing P50 expression test surface
Do not introduce a new test framework

userStories.title: Add age-25 baseline guard surface
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a narrow age-25 guard for the most important mid-run outputs so future tuning does not silently weaken the current merchant or route-state baseline.
acceptanceCriteria: Define a minimum age-25 guard for seeds 301, 303, and 804
Cover current-goal output and any must-keep mid-run line signal
Reuse existing replay or spine tests instead of duplicating the harness
If snapshots are used, keep them small and readable

userStories.title: Add age-40 identity baseline guard surface
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a narrow age-40 guard for the dedicated identity outputs so future tuning does not silently break the current line closures.
acceptanceCriteria: Define a minimum age-40 guard for seeds 301, 303, and 804
Cover age-40 identity done flags and player-facing identity output
Reuse existing replay or spine tests instead of duplicating the harness
Avoid broad full-report snapshots when a narrow assertion is enough

userStories.title: Add baseline guard runner or script alias
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want one small command for sample-line hardening checks so future sessions can rerun the post-P51 baseline cheaply.
acceptanceCriteria: Provide a small baseline-guard entry point or documented alias
Include P50 spine, P50 expression, and P49 replay checks
Do not replace gate:playability with this guard

userStories.title: Document cheap guard versus full gate workflow
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want the guard-running workflow written down so future sessions know when the cheap sample-line guard is sufficient and when the full playability gate is required.
acceptanceCriteria: Document when to run the cheap guard and when to run gate:playability
Explain the intended use of the guard runner in the repo's sample-line workflow
Keep the workflow note near the guard command or closure addendum
Do not add new runtime behavior in this story

userStories.title: Produce P52 closure addendum
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a P52 closure addendum so the repo can distinguish 'P51 baseline passes' from 'P52 baseline is hardened and cross-tester checked'.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce docs/test-reports/p52-baseline-hardening-closure-report.md
Summarize round-2 playtest, cross-tester comparison, and automated-guard additions
List which residual items remain monitor-only after P52
Do not reopen already-closed P46-P51 blockers
userStories.notes: Completed FIX-013 closure addendum; A1 verify PASS; A2 finalize complete.
